upstream.description: Hundreds of models & providers. One command to find what runs on your hardware.

classification.analysis: llmfit (repo name llm-whatgives, upstream AlexsJones/llmfit) is a Rust terminal tool that detects a machine's RAM, CPU, and GPU/VRAM, then scores hundreds of LLM models across fit, speed, quality, and context to recommend which will actually run well on that hardware. It ships an interactive TUI plus a classic CLI/JSON mode for scripting, supports multi-GPU and MoE architectures, dynamic quantization selection, and integrates with local runtime providers (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, Docker Model Runner, LM Studio), with a community benchmark-sharing system for real tok/s numbers. It targets developers and self-hosters deciding which local LLM to download and run on their specific hardware.

use_cases.title: Find which local LLMs will run well on your specific GPU/CPU/RAM
Get a JSON-formatted model recommendation for a script or agent
Benchmark real tok/s on your machine and compare to community results
Pick a quantization and runtime provider (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX) for a given model
